speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what is the current number of (i) Police Officers and (ii) crimes committed, per 100,000 population; and (b) how do these figures compare with other major cities in the world like London, New York and Hong Kong.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: This low crime rate has been achieved with a lean Police Force.

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Mr Christopher de Souza, you have a question?

speaker: Mdm Speaker
text: Can I remind Members to put up your hands quickly because, otherwise, I will call the next Member?

speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: The Senior Minister of State also mentioned it is low compared to three cities.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It is a variety of considerations that lead to this – not only a well-trained, efficient Police Force that is in touch with the community but also good laws.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Law and order are a product of good laws.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Nevertheless, I think the Member is quite right to point out that this manpower constraint is likely to persist.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: That is contrasted with a much larger workload – public expectations, more travellers, more infrastructure, higher demands on our SCDF and so on and so forth.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: There are many strategies that we will adopt in order to tackle this challenge.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: For example, we will enhance our recruitment terms to retain, recruit and advance our officers.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: We will also review our operations and revisit them so that we can do things better.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: It is not feasible to keep growing the SCDF and the number of its ambulances and paramedics.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: So, we need to do better, we need to use data analytics to have a tiered and differentiated response.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: This is an example of doing things better.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Thirdly, we will improve our officers' capabilities, so that each officer can do more.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: I spoke of the fast response car yesterday, with more technology built in it to allow officers to respond faster and better.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: We spoke yesterday also of technology to allow us to do more with less.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Hair analyses are able to detect drug consumption over a longer period of time.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: This allows us to recall these offenders less often to the station and allows us to redeploy these officers to other duties.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Lastly, of course, we will strengthen community partnership, which is one of the things I spoke about at length yesterday.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: All these will help us to do more with a lean Force.
